modalLead: Small tools in the search panel for subnets, hashes, cron lines and more, clean titles for the RSS widget and Watch feeds, and a round of fixes.

items.text: Small tools in the search panel. Type a subnet like 192.168.1.0/24, a cron line like cron 0 9 * * 1-5, sha256 or md5 and a text, base64, uuid, pass 20, a port such as 8096, a Unix time or chmod 755, and the answer is the top row. Enter copies it. A cron line says what it means and when it runs next.
Help while you type a tool. The first letters of a tool's word, like cr or sha, show how to use it, and a word with a space after it shows working examples you can pick.
Paste into the search panel. Cmd+V or Ctrl+V now puts the copied text into an open panel.
A copy that fails says so and shows the text, instead of doing nothing.

Clean up titles in the RSS widget. In the widget's settings, cut a pattern out of every title, such as an advisory number in front. Suggest proposes one from the feed's own titles, and a before and after shows the effect.
A widget on every page keeps a change made on another page, even when a tab still shows the old one.
Clean up titles per feed. Each watched feed can cut a pattern out of its titles, with Suggest and a preview. The list, the bell and the notices show the cleaned titles.
This weekend in a reminder means the coming Saturday or Sunday, also on a Saturday morning.
Compose fixes. Apply waits for a save that is still running, an override file adds ports to a stack instead of replacing them, and a restart that was missed no longer shows as a restart loop.
